name: Plate 40 x 20 x 5 with two holes
description: Flat plate 40 x 20 x 5 mm (X x Y x Z) with two 4 mm through holes, 30 mm apart (15 mm each side of centre), on the centre line of the long axis, 5 mm from each end. Prints flat on the 40 x 20 face with no supports. Assumed: holes go all the way through, plain round, no chamfer. Not printed or fitted.
